title: Sources: Leopold Aschenbrenner discussed "Situational Awareness 2.0", a reboot using leverage and outside capital, four months after Citadel rescued his fund (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: Leopold Aschenbrenner discussed “Situational Awareness 2.0”, a reboot using leverage and outside capital, four months after Citadel rescued his fund — The 25-year-old AI trader has held talks about employing leverage again and raising funds after wipeout nearly toppled firm
